items.title: Allegiant, Long an OTA Holdout, Signs an Exclusive Deal With Expedia
items.summary: A shrinking number of airlines shun online travel agency distribution. Allegiant's deal with Expedia Group means it abandoned its direct-distribution-only strategy — one that it touted as advantageous as late as February 2026.

items.title: Delta Adds LAX-Manila Route as the Battle for West Coast and Asia Heats Up
items.summary: Delta is focusing international growth out of the West Coast, looking to become the dominant carrier out of LAX.

items.title: Hilton’s Chris Nassetta: Why 28 Brands Aren’t Too Many and the ‘Bazillion Points’ Problem
items.summary: Hilton CEO Chris Nassetta defended the company's need for 28 brands as a data-driven strategy rather than sprawl, while also pointing to AI as the next lever for fixing guest problems in the moment.

items.title: Travel’s Creator Economy Doesn’t Need a Million Followers. It Needs Proof It Converts.
items.summary: Brands spent years building creator partnerships around follower counts. Now, they're increasingly after deals they know drive real sales.

items.title: Brussels Airlines Taps ITA Airways Exec for CEO
items.summary: Incoming Brussels Airlines CEO Lorenza Maggio oversaw ITA Airways’ merger into Lufthansa Group, which was one of the fastest integrations in the company’s history.

items.title: Say Goodbye to $9 Tickets. Higher Fares Are Here to Stay, United CEO Says
items.summary: United CEO Scott Kirby argues that surging fuel costs aren’t entirely responsible for higher airfares. Instead airlines are capitalizing on more pricing power driven by ballooning operating costs and a readjustment in domestic capacity.

items.title: Fora Travel the Unicorn: It Raised $60 Million at a $1 Billion Valuation
items.summary: Fora Travel has carved out a nice niche for itself as it taps into the desires of a younger generation of travel advisors passionate about travel and looking for side hustles. Its $1 billion valuation came after just five years in business.

items.title: MakeMyTrip Set to File for India IPO at $1 Billion-Plus: Report
items.summary: MakeMyTrip has talked about an India listing for months. A confidential filing — if the report holds — would be the clearest sign yet the company is moving from considering it to doing it.
